 Jacksonville Jaguar News: Would you trade WR Brian Thomas Jr.?
 Will the Jaguars end up trading WR Brian Thomas Jr. before next week’s deadline?
 by Michael Peterson Nov 4, 2026, 3:11 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Just a straight-forward discussion this morning.
 As one of the only names on the Jaguars still being floated around as a potential trade candidate, where do you stand on potentially moving wide receiver Brian Thomas Jr.? Will his value be enough to warrant moving such a player? Would you rather keep him and hope he returns to his rookie form sooner rather than later? Is an additional draft pick more valuable than what he’s currently providing the Jaguars on offense?
 Go ahead and drop in the comments to tell us all of your thoughts!
